title: Approximate tangent planes of the cylinder (0,1) × M are ℝe₀ ⊕ J(TₓM) almost everywhere (parent steps 2 and 6)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and M ⊆ ℝ^N be Borel, countably n-rectifiable, with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ (Hᵈ := μHE[d]). Put Ψ(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), M̃ := Ψ((0, 1) × M), e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, Jv := Ψ(0, v), and for a subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^N, Q̃ := span(insert e₀ (J(Q))). Then for H^{n+1}-a.e. y ∈ M̃ the following holds: for all t ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N with y = Ψ(t, x) and every subspace Q such that M has approximate tangent space Q at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q), M̃ has approximate tangent space Q̃ at y (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (n+1) M̃ y Q̃).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid N)), MeasurableSet M → CountablyRectifiable n M → μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n + 1].restrict ((fun p : ℝ × Euclid N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons p.1 (WithLp.ofLp p.2)) : Euclid (N + 1))) '' (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ M))), ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), y = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid N), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt (n + 1) ((fun p : ℝ × Euclid N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons p.1 (WithLp.ofLp p.2)) : Euclid (N + 1))) '' (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ M)) y (Submodule.span ℝ (insert (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) ((fun v : Euclid N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v)) : Euclid (N + 1))) '' (Q : Set (Euclid N)))))
